name: @aethelred/wallet-local
description: Local workspace for Aethelred Wallet execution

scripts.test:property: cd apps/extension && npx vitest run property
scripts.test:fuzz: cd apps/extension && npx vitest run fuzz
scripts.test:a11y: cd apps/extension && npx vitest run a11y
scripts.test:contract: cd apps/extension && npx vitest run contract

devDependencies._comment_sharp: sharp is used ONLY by scripts/optimize-images.mjs — an opt-in, manual script. It is never a runtime dep and is not required for npm run build:extension. The script no-ops with a clear install message if sharp is missing, so CI does not require it either.
